objective: Produce a working checkpoint whose ENTIRE observation-to-action control path is learned. Functional deployment boundary, not MTSK superiority or a C5 scaling claim.
prior_error: DEV055/056 left analytical cost argmin, entity addressing and verification outside learning. DEV057 tested hand-coded lookup only. Do not relabel those as a fully learned agent.

deployment_contract.allowed_inputs: Public event feature tensors, public candidate action descriptors and public entity-query descriptors, padding/presence masks, previous opaque tensor memory; no simulator object, hidden state, teacher outputs, costs/transition tables or symbolic planner.
deployment_contract.learned: Event encoding, admission/write gate, memory write address, content-based CDL reads, structural graph and neural CASM composition, action-conditioned latent transitions/rollout, outcome/cost/completion forecasts, future-action proposal and actual action policy. Corrective actions and stopping are policy outputs, never scripted retries or stop thresholds.
deployment_contract.allowed_programming: Neural tensor operators, finite latent-memory/rollout budgets, tensor padding, argmax of trained logits, public API transport, simulator and independent execution/verification outside the agent. No per-entity runtime state dictionaries, address-by-entity slot rules, repair/inspection heuristics, analytical belief updates or cost argmin in agent code.
deployment_contract.export: Single self-contained torch-only model module + learned weights/config + public JSON interface; must run in a subprocess without tac_osm/environment/teacher imports.

world.identifiers: Random opaque 8-way public codes and randomized candidate ordering; no stable entity-to-memory-slot mapping.
world.physics: Publicly described disjoint parent-child couplings. Repair of a faulty child is blocked while parent faulty. Otherwise faulty repair succeeds .95. Needless repair of a healthy parent can fault its child with probability .8. Inspect returns exact target status. Simulator-only rules are not imported by agent.
world.observations: Initial exact status and coupling records interleaved with irrelevant records; subsequent exact action receipts. Neural memory must retain latest status and relations.
world.actions: Public descriptors for inspect/repair of every entity plus stop; all real actions remain available, with padding mask only. Stop may fail. Horizon2*N+4 is external budget, not a retry controller.
world.costs: Each observed record .01, each admitted memory write .02, repair .6, inspect .1, terminal residual fault20. Report acquisition/write/action/failure costs separately and actual inference work. Reliability primary.

model.mechanism: Learned allocation over generic slots, not entity-assigned slots. Address/admission pretraining may be frozen after convergence; frozen TRAINED weights are allowed and disclosed. Latent-value encoder/read/graph/operators/dynamics/verifier/policy train from task data. Learned CASM is neural program composition; do not claim general symbolic DSL discovery.

training.memory_labels: Training-only admission, generic free-slot allocation, latest public status/relation read targets. Admission charged .02 in objective; never invoke training labels in deployment.
training.policy_labels: Simulator/teacher-assisted imitation of any safe progress repair or stop when complete; counterfactual action outcomes and successor action labels supervise learned transitions and policy. This is explicitly teacher-assisted learning, not discovery from reward alone. Teachers are training/evaluation-only and excluded from export.
training.cache: May cache public records retained by the pretrained NEURAL writer for offline training; no oracle record selection and no raw-history cache at deployment. Verify streaming/cache parity.
training.losses: Policy CE, learned future-action CE, current/next completion BCE, next-state fault BCE, future outcome BCE, proper cost regression, read-address auxiliary CE, admission/write cost. Log each component and gradients/weight changes.

selection: Development functional target on validation only. Try recipes in order, stop at first that meets autonomous validation target, then replicate at second seed. Preserve failures. No final-test selection or hidden heuristic rescue. Final test opened only after selecting recipe/fit by validation.
functional_target: On each validation cell N2/4 xH32/96 >=.90 all-faults-resolved autonomous worlds; N6 cells >=.80. On fresh test same named thresholds. Every decision including stop/correction from checkpoint. A miss is incomplete, never declared fully working by CI alone.

evaluation.unit: 576 independent worlds per initialization, paired across lesions/controls; not1152 independent worlds.
evaluation.controls: Untrained policy, zero memory, forced-all-writes, uniform reads, CASM bypass, zero dynamics, zero policy. Same-checkpoint lesions establish dependence, not mechanism superiority. Report greedy learned versus sampled actions if used; no cost planner fallback.
evaluation.diagnostics: Completion/reliability, final faults, cost terms, actual skipped writes/read slots/operator calls; predictions proper scores; all module gradients/parameter changes; memory capacity, training curves; candidate permutation equivariance and label-tampering invariance.

audit: Restore both selected checkpoints in separate process; exact public input/action/receipt replay; no teacher at inference; AST/import audit and exported torch-only subprocess. Native Veritas replays new synthetic recorded trajectories, with same-author/shared-generator limitation. Preserve failed worlds and checkpoint/source hashes.
budget: Bounded validation-driven development, up to3 recipes and2 selected-seed fits, target45 process-minutes CPU; no paid compute. Smoke/test seeds8581xxx disjoint. No MTSK novelty pursuit. Complete functional target where achievable; if budget exhausted preserve partial evidence and report unmet requirements without relabeling programmed parts as learned.
amendment_A1_before_main_outcomes: Training-only public-relation graph-edge targets may supervise the learned CASM adjacency; no graph labels enter runtime. Exact public receipts report every changed entity, so teacher policy does not have an information advantage over complete public history. Record this supervision explicitly; do not call it unsupervised program discovery.
